newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to receive Band B telephone concession bids.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to receive Band B telephone concession bids.

text.p: The Brazilian government is to receive bids on Monday for 10 regional B Band cellular telephone concessions in the first stage of the country's huge telecommunications privatisation plan, Brazilian newspapers said on Sunday.
At least 10 international consortia are expected to submit their proposals in a program which should raise about $6 billion in license fees, newspapers said.
Sunday's Estado de Sao Paulo newspaper said the winners should be known by the end of May and the first contracts signed in June.
The tender comes at an opportune time after last week's long-awaited telephone rate hike which resulted in common and preferred shares in Telebras stock jumping up to six percent on April 4.
Last week the Supreme Federal Tribunal (STF) also ruled the Communications Ministry could regulate the telecommunications industry while an official regulator is being set up.
The regulator issue was considered the biggest potential road block in the way of the B Band program.
((-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
